models: Impedance by formula (Hammerstad-Jensen, Wheeler, conformal mapping for coplanar lines, IPC-2141); single and coplanar lines within about 2 %, offset striplines and differential pairs can be off by 5–15 %. Losses: Wheeler/Huray/Djordjevic-Sarkar.
tolerance_note: z_tol_rss_ohm / z_tol_wc_ohm: the band of the mean impedance for the fab's manufacturing tolerances (tolerances: defaults from data/stackups.json, mostly estimates, < kisi.json "tolerances" < --tol), RSS and worst case of one-at-a-time formula sensitivities scaled to the impedance; z_tol_status against the class's window: inside, band_leaves (nominal inside, RSS band not), nominal_outside. Usually larger than the calculation uncertainty (accuracy). Information: no verdict uses it.

tolerances.about: Default manufacturing tolerances for the impedance band (`kisi overview --tolerance`, `kisi stackups --tolerance`, the viewer's stackup panel), each ± around the nominal value, and the default target window where a net class has no interface profile. Values named in `estimates` are kisi estimates from the sources, not a fab's guarantee; change them with --tol or in the viewer.

sources.text: dielectric_thickness_pct 10 (estimate): JLCPCB's board thickness tolerance (±10 % for 1.0 mm and thicker, PCB capabilities page) applied to every dielectric; a fab's pressed prepreg thickness depends on the copper it fills and the resin flow.

er_pct 5 (estimate): the spread of published εr for the same JLC core – 4.6 (JITX, 'from Impedance Control Specifications from JLC-PCB') against 4.36 … 4.43 from the NP-155F datasheet by core thickness – is 4 … 5 %; fabs publish no εr tolerance.

copper_pct 10 (estimate): IPC-4562 allows the base foil up to 10 % below its nominal weight (Eurocircuits, Tolerances on copper thickness); inner layers lose more to cleaning and micro-etching (18 µm foil: at least 11.4 µm after processing, IPC-A-600J class 2) and plated outer copper varies more – the trace layer's thickness, symmetric.

width_mm 0.02 (estimate): JLCPCB's track width tolerance is ±20 % with the example 0.08 … 0.12 mm for a 0.1 mm track; kisi takes the example's ±0.02 mm as an absolute etch tolerance for every width (etching removes about the same copper from every edge, so the absolute tolerance hardly grows with the width). Symmetric: each copper edge moves by half of it, gaps shrink as widths grow; no etch factor (trapezoid).

window_pct 10: JLCPCB's standard impedance tolerance ±10 % (±5 % on special request), PCB capabilities page (fetched 2026-11-06). A net class's interface profile, where it has one, gives its own window (z_tol_pct).
